The perspeconic of the inner and outer Grebe triangles is a circle, here named the **Grebe circle**. X_33703 = inverse-in-Grebe-circle of X_186. (Randy Hutson, August 19, 2019)

Let A'B'C' be the mid-triangle of the tangential and intangents triangles. Let L_{A} be the reflection of line B'C' in the external angle bisector of A, and define L_{B}, L_{C} cyclically. Let A" = L_{B} ∩ L_{C}, and define B", C" cyclically. Triangle A"B"C" is homothetic to ABC at X_2 and to the Euler triangle at X_3850. X_33703 = X_20-of-A"B"C". (Randy Hutson, August 19, 2019)
